buyer_validation: Actual purchases not measured; requested decision is estimated utility.

value.evidence: Six fixed scenarios on Papier, systeme.io and Loops, including the complete sequence, are useful after ordinary review/local optional editing.
value.consequence: Sufficient estimated utility to sell the email preparation/generation/edit/export service.

effort.evidence: One real UI creation/run without optional settings; others API.
effort.consequence: Novice autonomy and active human time not measured.

reliability.evidence: All8 chosen emails pass current deterministic checks; full sequence supplied3/3. Stale proposal acceptance is rejected after peer changes. Historical failures and original execution review status preserved.
reliability.consequence: Facts and sequence context survive editing; source and brand review remain part of using generated copy.

economics.evidence: Known minimum804 completed calls across preparation, failed/corrective campaigns,4 direct controls and11 revision jobs; one historical map counter unknown. Full latest sequence92 calls, latest optional proposals1 call each.
economics.consequence: No verified margins or human minutes saved; catalog dollar estimates are not bills.

usability.evidence: Actual UI default no-steering path, diff, accept/decline/adjust further, original/history, exact current copy/download and current selection checks verified.
usability.consequence: The chosen deliverable is the version copied/exported.

reuse.evidence: Papier and systeme campaigns reused unchanged compiled knowledge; no new compile calls.
reuse.consequence: Second campaign can reuse existing preparation.

direct_model_advantage.evidence: Four useful direct controls with prepared brand context. Workflow value in source preparation/reuse, user controls, validation and versioned editing/export.
direct_model_advantage.consequence: Sell the reusable controlled workflow; do not promise better prose on every request.
